description: Eswatini - Powerlines is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Power system and utilities, Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Min Jaegal (World Bank Group). This dataset demonstrates powerlines in Eswatini. It contains low voltage (440V) and 11kV distribution networks as well as higher voltage transmission grid data provided by EEC. It is in shapefile (line) and CSV format. Coverage: Eswatini. It has 2 files in ZIP, TILE. The portal files it under Power system and utilities, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence (terms as labelled in the catalogue, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
